description: Provider-free generic AI package for data provider registries, request/response envelopes, pagination, rate-limit metadata, auth redaction, cache/retry policy, provenance, error envelopes, and clean skips.
test_gates: data provider registry contract fixtures decode without provider SDK imports
request and response envelope contract fixtures remain provider-free and replayable
pagination and rate-limit contract fixtures are metadata-only and deterministic
auth redaction and provenance contract fixtures never expose secret values
error envelope and clean-skip contract fixtures cover disabled network and absent credential states

no_built_in_guarantee.statement: Leia core does not provide built-in leia-generic-ai-data-provider-boundary provider SDKs, credentials, network clients, caches, or domain schemas; this provider-free package boundary owns provider registry, request/response envelope, pagination, rate-limit, auth redaction, cache/retry, provenance, error, and clean-skip contracts.

credentials.policy: No credentials are declared by leia-generic-ai-data-provider-boundary; provider credentials belong only to provider-specific adapter packages behind explicit capability gates.
